scripts.build: npm i && npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:prod: npm ci && (cd app/shared && npm i --no-audit && npm run build) && (cd app/api && npm run build:prod) && (cd app/web && npm run build:prod)
scripts.dev: npm i --no-audit && npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web 'npm run dev:shared' 'npm run dev:api' 'npm run dev:web'
scripts.lint: npm i --no-audit && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web 'npm run lint:shared' 'npm run lint:api' 'npm run lint:web'
scripts.migrate: npm run tunnel & tunnel=$!; trap "kill $tunnel" EXIT INT TERM; cd app/api && npm i && npm run migrate
scripts.prepare: concurrently -n shared,api,web 'cd app/shared && npm i --no-audit && npm run build' 'cd app/api && npm i --no-audit' 'cd app/web && npm i --no-audit'
scripts.pre-push: npm ci && npm run build && npm run test:unit && ./scripts/e2e.sh
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:e2e: rm -rf app/web/build app/api/build && npm run build:shared && VITE_CRASH_HOOKS=1 npm run build:api && VITE_CRASH_HOOKS=1 npm run build:web
scripts.serve:e2e: concurrently -k -n api,web 'cd app/api && npm run start:e2e' 'cd app/web && npm run serve:e2e'
